description.value: Aloha Hawaiian Grill is a family-owned fast-casual restaurant in Richmond bringing Hawaiian plate lunch culture to the BC coast, with signature dishes like Huli Huli Chicken, Maui Beef Ribs, and shave ice served in a laid-back, island-themed setting. The restaurant celebrates the multicultural food heritage of Hawaii and treats guests like 'ohana' (family). It also offers corporate and event catering, making it a convenient stop for larger cycling groups.

address.value: Unit 110 - 3900 Bayview Street, Richmond, BC V7E 4R7

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 11m; rack at 65m; rack at 92m; rack at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business name, address (Unit #110 - 3900 Bayview St, Richmond, BC V7E 4R7), and phone number matching OSM tags. The menu page confirms takeout/online ordering and explicitly lists vegetarian items (Maui Tofu, Vegetarian Spring Rolls) plus gluten-free options (garlic shrimp, spam) and a catering testimonial notes vegan options available on request.
